SNEHAL YESANE

US Healthcare SME | Senior Business Analysis | Project Management

+91 7972994496

snehal.yesane93@gmail.com

in LinkedIn

Seeking a challenging role as a Senior Business Analyst / Project Manager / Life Sciences & Healthcare Consultant where expertise in translating complex business requirements into actionable solutions, managing cross-functional stakeholders, optimizing healthcare processes, and leveraging data, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled solutions can deliver measurable business value and support enterprise-scale healthcare initiatives.

Core Competencies

Profile Summary

Healthcare Business Analysis

A visionary professional with 9+ years of experience spanning Business Analysis, Project Management, Healthcare Operations, Claims Processing, and Process Optimization across Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial healthcare programs.

Project Management

Stakeholder Management

Proven expertise in business requirements elicitation, functional analysis, business-rule validation, process mapping, data validation, root-cause analysis, UAT, and solution delivery, effectively translating complex healthcare requirements into actionable business and analytical solutions.

Delivery Governance

Claims Processing & Adjudication

Strong domain acumen across claims life cycle, claims adjudication, payment accuracy, payer/provider operations, member data, utilization management, and healthcare data analysis, serving as a trusted US Healthcare Domain SME.

Payment Integrity & Payment Accuracy

Medicare, Medicaid & Commercial

Demonstrated project and delivery leadership through Agile project lifecycles, scope management, milestone governance, stakeholder workshops, risk mitigation, sprint planning, change management, and cross-functional collaboration with global teams and senior stakeholders.

Business Requirements & Functional Requirements

Spearheaded AI-enabled process transformation using Microsoft Copilot, automating and optimizing 20+ manual workflows and supporting the development/automation of 50+ operational reports and dashboards, strengthening delivery efficiency, reporting governance, and decision support.

Healthcare Data Analysis & Validation

Business Rules & Claims Validation

Stakeholder Management & Cross- Functional Collaboration

Proven capability in managing end-to-end project lifecycles, encompassing scope definition, requirement planning, stakeholder alignment, risk mitigation, milestone governance, Agile sprint planning, change management, UAT, and delivery tracking, while coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure on-time, quality-driven execution of strategic healthcare initiatives.

SQL, Power BI & Healthcare Analytics

Career Timeline

Certifications

PMI-PgMP® (Program

Management Professional)

2017-19

2019-21

2021-26

PMI-RMP® (Risk Management

Professional)

Certified Project Management Professional (PMP)® – Project Management Institute (PMI)

Technical Skills & Key Expert Areas

Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP)® – Simplilearn / IIBA

Healthcare Domains: Payment Integrity, Payment Accuracy, Claims Processing, Claims Adjudication, Claims Validation, Utilization Management, Care Management, Provider Data, Member Data, Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, Appeals

Scrum Foundation Certification – Scrum Alliance

Business Analysis Fundamentals

Business Analysis & Processes: Business Systems Analysis, Business Requirements, Functional Requirements, Business Rules, Process Mapping, Data Validation, Data Mapping, Data Reconciliation, Requirement Gathering, Gap Analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Solution Validation, Stakeholder Workshops, UAT

LinkedIn Learning

Technical & AI Tools: SQL, SAS, Power BI, Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot, JIRA, Confluence, ARISg,

10X Leadership Mindset –

SCEPTRE

Etyma Ed Ventures Pvt. Ltd.

Project & Governance: Project Lifecycle (PEC), Scope Management, Risk Mitigation, Milestone Tracking,

Leading Beyond the Titles – Neucode Talents

Sprint Planning, Agile Deliverables, Change Management, SLA / OLA Reporting

Achievements

Star & Spot Awards | Evolent Health – Recognized for cross- skilled stakeholder engagement and collaboration, fostering strong cross-functional relationships and enabling seamless delivery across diverse teams and functions.

Empaneled Corporate Trainer | Evolent Health – Selected as a core internal trainer for Business Analysis fundamentals.

Spotlight Recognition | Cotiviti – Awarded for outstanding operational audit performance.

Smart Performer | Sciformix – Achieved 100% processing targets and delivery quality metrics.

Education

2017 M.Pharm. MAEERS Maharashtra Institute of Pharmacy, Pune (Special Distinction: Best Outgoing Student Award)

2015 B.Pharm. Bharati Vidyapeeth College of Pharmacy, Kolhapur

Soft Skills

Negotiation & Conflict

Management

Team Building & Interpersonal

Skills

Analytical Problem Solving Visionary and Decision Making High Business Ethics &

Trustworthy Leadership and Delegation

Work Experience

Evolent India, Pune Senior Analyst (US Healthcare-Domain SME) Key Result Areas:

Aug’21 – Jul’26

Governed end-to-end project lifecycles, including scope baselines, requirements, milestones, delivery

health, risk mitigation, and governance across Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial programs.

Analyzed and validated claims data, adjudication rules, and critical attributes including CPT, HCPCS, ICD- 10, modifiers, POS, and paid/denied statuses to ensure data integrity and business-rule compliance.

Drove alignment across 30+ technical and business stakeholders while partnering with Product, Clinical,

Operations, and Implementation teams to translate business needs into actionable solutions.

Directed the design, deployment, and lifecycle governance of 50+ business-critical reports, dashboards,

and KPI frameworks to strengthen operational visibility and management decision-making. Spearheaded Microsoft Copilot-driven automation initiatives across 20+ manual operational workflows, enhancing productivity, accelerating turnaround cycles, and reducing execution risks. Facilitated Agile ceremonies, requirement-grooming workshops, impact assessments, backlog discussions, and UAT activities in collaboration with global US-based project teams.

Conducted data validation, reconciliation, exception analysis, and root-cause investigations to improve

reporting accuracy, business-rule adherence, and operational reliability.

Established functional documentation, process flows, onboarding frameworks, mentoring mechanisms,

and audit-ready governance aligned with HIPAA and enterprise delivery standards.

Cotiviti India Pvt. Ltd., Pune 2019-05 – 2021-08 Specialist - Payment Accuracy & Audit Track Lead Key Result Areas:

May’19 – Aug’21

Performed end-to-end Payment Integrity and Payment Accuracy validation for Commercial healthcare

claims across multiple audit programs, strengthening claim accuracy and audit effectiveness.

Coordinated UHC and BCBS duplicate claim analysis and Rx audit tracks, ensuring timely workflow

execution and effective identification of potential payment discrepancies.

Governed clinical validation activities across ICD, CPT, NDC, and HCPCS standards, ensuring accurate

interpretation and application of healthcare coding and audit rules. Investigated claim exceptions, conducted root-cause analysis, and identified potential payment leakage opportunities in collaboration with business stakeholders.

Analyzed delivery pipelines, identified operational bottlenecks, optimized target parameters, and provided

production support to improve audit workflow efficiency and quality.

Developed master training curricula, SOPs, and training documentation for audit teams while serving as

an internal core trainer to strengthen process consistency and knowledge capability.

Sciformix Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (Covance), Pune Junior Safety Data Analyst Key Result Areas:

Aug’17 – May’19

Managed end-to-end case triage pipelines and workflow activities within ARISg and SCEPTRE safety

environments, ensuring timely and structured case processing.

Validated, monitored, and tracked critical Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs) to maintain data accuracy,

case quality, and adherence to established processing standards.

Monitored safety workflows and schedule checkpoints to ensure compliance with regulatory timelines and

organizational pharmacovigilance requirements.

Maintained audit-ready safety operations by ensuring case records, workflow checkpoints, and supporting

documentation remained aligned with defined compliance parameters.

Enforced standard operating procedures across safety case-processing activities, supporting consistent

execution and adherence to defined quality benchmarks.

Tracked operational workflows and critical case milestones, identifying potential deviations and ensuring

timely corrective action to sustain workflow continuity and quality.
